caption: LUM-1266: 120x23 — folded header + visible composer, and the chat-log scrollbar in its own column beside full-width /help rows

panels.label: 1. 8s idle at 120x23: folded header (title + folded-hints row), composer, status bar — the LUM-1260 build had 0 composer rows here
2. a real turn lands in the transcript
3. /help<Enter> -> command surface fills the transcript; every row keeps its last character
4. /hotkeys<Enter> -> the transcript now overflows, so the scrollbar is drawn on the frame's last column
5. PgUp -> scrolled back: the thumb moves off the bottom, no text row lost a character to the bar
